original_test_intent: Run approved DirectX 12 Time Spy while the Windows physical display path is actually 2560x1440, validate result/display stability and detect new ECC/platform errors under the 1440p load.
original_method: Verify licensed artifact and exact preset, bind requested/active/physical 2560x1440 mode, capture baseline health, run the approved bounded benchmark, retain full validity/score and physical display evidence, compare ECC/events and recover/cool the session.
manual_activity: Operator verifies the physical 2560x1440 scanout and watches display stability while the agent may launch the licensed bounded benchmark and collect resolution-specific result and health evidence after confirmation.
required_inputs: 2560x1440 monitor/link, refresh, scaling, HDR and physical path
Benchmark render/output settings, preset, loops and 20-minute boundary
Expected score range and validity rule
Dedicated window, explicit confirmation, operator and recovery path
safety_requirements: Do not install from unapproved third-party source
Do not run on active production workload
Verify requested and actually negotiated 2560x1440 scanout
Do not confuse Time Spy render size with physical output mode
Stop on thermal/power/link/driver fault, hang, artifact, invalid score or new unacceptable ECC/event
Use complete ECC/event evidence, not grep alone
agent_execution_scope: Verify package/license, GPU/driver and actual display mode read-only
Collect complete result/validity/score and GPU/BMC/Windows evidence
Correlate operator physical visual and link observations
Stop, preserve evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve package and exact 1440p display/benchmark settings

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The broad launch/capture plan fits, but it lacks actual Windows/monitor 2560x1440 proof and could confuse benchmark render resolution with scanout. It also lacks executable/preset, artifact provenance and thresholds.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, run the pinned licensed Time Spy preset on the verified 2560x1440 Windows/physical output path for the approved count; collect full result validity, requested/active/negotiated mode, physical video and complete health/ECC evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DirectX12, v2.20.7274 plus Time Spy, 2560x1440 identity and 15/20-minute metadata remain; no score, refresh, loops or thresholds are invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: READY AFTER 1440P MODE, PACKAGE, THRESHOLD AND STRESS APPROVAL
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind physical 1440p scanout separately from benchmark render settings, then correlate result validity/score, physical pixels, link stability and pre/post GPU/ECC/platform health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the resolution layer explicit and adds artifact provenance, limits and complete evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The same benchmark can run at a fixed internal render resolution while Windows or the monitor outputs another mode; a score/screenshot alone cannot prove the named 1440p path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: 1440p refresh/HDR/link choices affect bandwidth and stability; high load can throttle or reset the driver, and untrusted installers add supply-chain risk.

project_override_considerations: Approve artifact/license/hash, actual 2560x1440 refresh/scaling/HDR/link, Time Spy render/output/preset/run count, score validity/range, ECC delta/severity, visual/link criteria, stress limits and recovery.
expected_evidence: Approved artifact/license/hash, Windows/DirectX/GPU/driver and display-link identities
Requested, active and physically negotiated 2560x1440 mode plus benchmark settings
Pre/post GPU thermal/power/driver, BMC ECC/SEL/SDR and Windows event comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title and Procedure consistently define a Windows 3DMark/Time Spy run whose unique identity is 2560x1440 display output. Criteria is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The benchmark and 1440p output purpose are identifiable. Artifact, settings and thresholds are owner/package prerequisites, so the case remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION.

review_improvement: Adds the 1440p render-versus-scanout distinction, resolution-specific link evidence, complete ECC comparison, provenance and stress recovery without reusing adjacent variants.
independent_technical_reasoning: A workload's internal render target and the Windows/monitor scanout mode are separate. The source names display at 2560x1440, so the evidence must prove the physical output tuple while Time Spy runs. Otherwise an unchanged benchmark score could be counted even though the named high-resolution display path was never exercised.
